positions.name: AnalyticsPipelinePlatform
positions.frame: what database platform carries the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 both state the migration from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline — one in prose, one as a formatted heading — cohering under the question of which platform underpins the pipeline.

positions.name: MigrationPerformanceRationale
positions.frame: what performance outcomes drive the database migration?
positions.why: src-2 and src-4 both assert a 10x analytical query performance gain — one as a combined performance-and-cost claim, one as a standalone performance heading — cohering under the question of what performance outcomes justify the switch.
